To optimize complexity, when calculating the in-degree of each node, sort and discretize; then, during a left-to-right scan, use a Fenwick tree to maintain the heights that have been scanned. Topological sorting uses a segment tree to optimize range in-degree modification, recording the minimum value in the segment tree, taking the root node each time, and using binary search to find the range where in-degree needs to be updated.
